title: Theory Trace Card: Theory-Driven Socio-Cognitive Evaluation of LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not introduce or use a benchmark to measure any aspect of faith or religion. It discusses moral reasoning benchmarks in general and notes that current, Western-centric evaluations often overlook moral concepts like 'sanctity' which can be related to religion, but this is used as an example of a broader evaluation problem, not as a measurement focus.
findings: This paper does not present any findings related to religion. Its focus is on proposing a methodological framework (the Theory Trace Card) for improving the transparency and validity of socio-cognitive evaluations of LLMs, not on conducting such evaluations itself.
